credits.title: Lxs Pilotxs
credits.overview: Carlos is a teenager who lives with his mother, Lily, waiting for Fernando, his father, who works as a truck driver. One weekend, Fernando comes home from work to try to take his place as the father of the family, while Carlos and Lily do everything they can to make him stay.

credits.title: Conversaciones
credits.overview: 10 fantastic and dark conversations tell us the story of a Mexican family through the relations and conflicts of two brothers.

credits.title: The Last Supper
credits.overview: Two children, a nun, and the horror of religious beliefs.

credits.title: Perras de barrio 4
credits.overview: Brenda and Sara are the most powerful women in Mexicali and they will do whatever it takes to maintain power no matter the consequences. A story full of action and eroticism that reflects today's society where the political class is involved with criminal groups to perpetuate themselves in power.
